cases.name: PEB factory shed: 30 m clear-span tapered welded portal frames, pinned bases, brick dado, Bengaluru
declared_assumptions: Site soil Type II pending geotechnical confirmation.
Trial connection details and matched source member checks are recorded where available. Each unverified design item retains review status.

Rooflight openings and separate translucent sheets occupy 3% of the gross main roof in plan and on the slope. Producer design uses a 1.5 mm polycarbonate envelope allowance; the supplier confirms sheet grade, curb and trimmer details, fall protection, overlaps, fasteners and watertight seals.
The endwall sheeting is set on outward-facing IS 811 Z rails. Remaining triangular verge infill, local corner closure, lap lengths, gable cleats and cladding fasteners require envelope detailing.
Continuous ridge ventilation is a specialist envelope package. Opening width, curb, flashing, local trimming and rain exclusion require the ventilator supplier specification.
The 230 mm masonry dado bears on its own plinth. Its out-of-plane ties, foundation and movement joints require local masonry and foundation detailing.

Portal eave and ridge values are fixed structural workline elevations. Across the main roof the inner skin is 850.2 mm vertically above that datum. The long façade is 846.0 mm outside the column grid. Roof and long-wall packing varies from 54.1 to 241.0 mm. The gable and door jamb attachments, outer cladding fixings, water seals and thermal movement require envelope-supplier details.

declared_assumptions: Two 46 by 18 m guest wings are joined by an 18 m long, 8 m wide corridor. Its opposite edges align with the end grids of the wings, producing two re-entrant corners. Mechanical roof allowance included.
Levels, member axes and all dimensions in the handoff are in millimetres. Verify site soil, opening ratios, terrain, heat numbers and supplier data.

Physical framing uses nominal analytic workpoints and untrimmed member ends. Panels follow structural control planes. Coordinate finish buildups, offsets, coping and weld preparations in fabrication details.
The native design gate and governing member checks travel with this model. Review open primary-frame, concrete, diaphragm and fastening checks before design acceptance.
Any proposed in-plane board stiffness and allowable shear require full assembly test evidence. Concrete pedestal and group breakout design must be verified.
Dead loads are preliminary assembly allowances. No imposed-load reduction is used. Primary member self-weight is computed separately by the solver.

Native levels are analytic structural worklines. Floor joists bear on girder flanges; roof purlins bear through their detailed seats. The issued board or roof skin starts on the upper flange. Supplier floor retention, deck fasteners and the podium deck/slab specification remain project inputs.

declared_assumptions: Two full podium plates with composite deck, five residential levels forming a U open to the north. Braced lines continue below the U to the foundation.
